We are supported by multiple NIH-funded grants and active communities of immunologists, molecular biologists, biochemists, data scientists, physician scientists, and computational biologists. Experience working in Unix/Linux environments, including shell scripting (Bash, awk, sed). Experience with single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, eQTL/pQTL analysis, and multimodal data integration.
